requests.snippet_a: Two periods are always taken into account: Previous calendar year (N-1) — rights vested through work in the prior year and not yet paid out through holidays taken in the current year. Current calendar year (N) — rights accrued from 1 January up to and including the last day of employment. Each period is settled at 15.34% of the gross earnings of that period: 7.67% simple holiday pay plus 7.67% double holiday pay.
requests.snippet_b: It is calculated on the current calendar year's earnings only. Take the gross earnings from January up to the leaving date and apply the 7.67% rate. The previous year is not relevant because holiday rights reset each January.
requests.question: An employee in Belgium earning 3,600 a month leaves on 30 April 2026. How much departure holiday pay we owe them?
